name: KeeneticOS MT7621 Entware Stage C: TZ-safe bootstrap, real rc.unslung service autostart across native reboot and QEMU reset

steps.send: printf '%s' '' | /opt/bin/busybox base64 -d > /opt/etc/init.d/S99labboot && /opt/bin/busybox chmod 700 /opt/etc/init.d/S99labboot && /opt/bin/busybox test -s /opt/etc/init.d/S99labboot && printf 'LABBOOT_%s\n' READY

/opt/bin/busybox test ! -e /opt/var/run/labboot.pid && /opt/bin/busybox test ! -e /opt/var/run/labboot.gen || exit 1; n=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"sleep 36""00"*) n=$((n+1));; esac; done; [ "$n" = 0 ] || exit 1; printf 'LABBOOT_%s\n' OFF

pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/labboot.pid); cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline); case "$cmd" in *sleep*3600*) /opt/bin/busybox cp /opt/var/run/labboot.pid /opt/var/run/labboot.pid1 && printf 'WORKER_%s\n' LIVE;; *) exit 1;; esac
n=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"sleep 36""00"*) n=$((n+1));; esac; done; [ "$n" = 1 ] && printf 'WORKER_%s\n' SINGLE
pid=$(/opt/bin/busybox cat /opt/var/run/labboot.pid); cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline); case "$cmd" in *sleep*3600*) printf 'WORKER_%s\n' LIVE;; *) exit 1;; esac
n=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do cmd=$(/opt/bin/busybox tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"sleep 36""00"*) n=$((n+1));; esac; done; [ "$n" = 1 ] && printf 'WORKER_%s\n' SINGLE
